summary: Ord's camping page (read by plain HTTP; robot-challenged in October) confirms RV hook-ups on first-come, first-served camper pads and the city phone (308) 728-5791; booking upgraded to manual. No dated rate anywhere (city silent; Campendium's $20 is a 2021 report). Pin OK on the concrete pads either side of the street at the park's east edge. Not waterfront stands: Aubles Pond is ~2.5 acres, ~50 m from the nearest pad through trees and the pond path; the North Loup River is ~1.3 km east across town.
flags: RATE unconfirmed: the city page posts no fee and none was found from the city; Campendium's '$20' (July 2021) is too old and fails the camper-report rule (the city has a page). Weak spot for the price gate; the city office (308) 728-5791 would settle it. The hookup mix, showers, dump and 12-site count in the note are from the earlier sweep and were not re-confirmed (left as they are).

WATERFRONT not waterfront stands: Aubles Pond flood-fills to ~2.5 acres (a pond under the ~5-acre line) and lies ~50 m NE of the north pads behind trees and its walking loop; North Loup River ~1.3 km east (brief ask).
